description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'AddRssItem' which provides a form for adding a new RSS feed item. It manages user input for a title and URL, handles button clicks for Submit and Cancel, and returns the result to the calling activity.

classes.name: AddRssItem
classes.description: An Android Activity providing a dialog form to add a new RSS feed, handling user input and returning the data.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, title, and button click listeners.
